entries.claim: The repo-root comment in new-design-brief's seed.sh says the case lives in evals/new-design-name/, but this file is in evals/new-design-brief/. The whole file was copied from Task 1's seed.sh, comment included.
entries.failure_scenario: Line 4 of evals/new-design-brief/seed.sh reads '# The case lives in evals/new-design-name/, so the repo is two levels up.' The file actually sits in evals/new-design-brief/. The repo line still resolves correctly because both folders are two levels deep, so no run fails. But anyone reading or vetting the seed is told the wrong case folder, and every other case's seed.sh names its own folder (for example cadence-project's and existing-brief's).
